analyze.prompt:
Analyze customer feedback for {product_name} focusing on one specific theme category.

Iteration: {iteration}
Feedback source: {feedback_source}

Previous iteration finding:
{theme_finding}

Prior analysis context:
{prior_analysis}

Focus this iteration on ONE of these categories (pick the one not yet covered):
- Usability: ease of use, navigation, learning curve, UX friction
- Features: requested features, missing capabilities, feature satisfaction
- Bugs: user-reported bugs, broken workflows, error messages
- Pricing: value perception, price sensitivity, plan comparisons
- Support: response times, resolution quality, documentation gaps

For your chosen category, provide:
CATEGORY: [which category]
SENTIMENT: [overall positive/mixed/negative]
KEY_THEMES: [3-5 recurring themes with frequency indicators]
SAMPLE_QUOTES: [2-3 representative customer statements]
ACTIONABLE_INSIGHTS: [specific product improvements suggested by this feedback]
SEVERITY: [how urgently this category needs attention - critical/important/moderate/low]

assess.prompt:
We have completed iteration {iteration} of customer feedback theme analysis for {product_name}.

Latest analysis:
{theme_finding}

Have we covered all five categories (usability, features, bugs, pricing, support)? If important categories remain unanalyzed, respond 'yes' to continue. If all categories are covered, respond 'done'.
